rank_delta_sign_convention: signed_rank_delta = masked_rank - baseline_rank. Ranks are 1-based with rank 1 the highest deterministic score. A POSITIVE signed_rank_delta means the ticker moved to a worse (higher-numbered) rank under masking; a NEGATIVE signed_rank_delta means it moved up (toward rank 1). absolute_rank_delta = abs(signed_rank_delta).
